        merged = {k: v for k, v in current.items() if not k.startswith("_")}
        merged.update(definition)
        merged["name"] = name
        merged["appCode"] = ac
        if message:
            merged["message"] = message
        return put(f"/api/ui/pages/{match['id']}", body=merged)
